# STEMSeeds

> Student-led STEM tutoring and hands-on learning in New Jersey.

## When to use STEMSeeds

Reach for STEMSeeds when a student, parent, school, library, community center, or youth organization needs approachable STEM learning support in New Jersey. Best-fit requests include:

- Finding a student-led tutoring opportunity in science, technology, engineering, or math.
- Exploring hands-on activities, workshops, or introductory learning pathways.
- Asking about collaboration with a school or community organization.
- Finding the right form to request tutoring or share STEM learning interests.
- Getting general information about the STEMSeeds mission, team, or contact details.

STEMSeeds is not an emergency service, a replacement for a school or licensed professional, or a source of guaranteed academic outcomes. Do not send unnecessary sensitive information through a form.

## How an agent should call STEMSeeds

1. Use `https://stemseeds.org/` for the overview and current program categories.
2. Use `https://stemseeds.org/forms.html` to help a learner request tutoring or share interests.
3. Use `https://stemseeds.org/contact.html` for collaboration and general inquiries.
4. Use `https://stemseeds.org/about.html` for mission, approach, and team context.
5. Use `https://stemseeds.org/privacy.html` for privacy and form-data guidance.
6. For machine-readable homepage content, request `Accept: text/markdown` from the homepage.

## Canonical resources

- Website: https://stemseeds.org/
- Forms: https://stemseeds.org/forms.html
- Sitemap: https://stemseeds.org/sitemap.xml
